test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d42ebddcc1a48aedb9158fa20e17a61f5eed731ae303051cc50c7cef1616652.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first and second elements from left interchange positions.
 
• Alternately third, fourth and fifth elements from left shifts in anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8b1d3cd6c054448351fe315bde6f2ff597c026f2abbef0cfa872e7c42cc4c2a.png] 

2) For second box alternate series:

 
• Alternately first and fifth elements from left interchange positions.
 
• Alternately second and fourth elements from left interchange positions. 
 
• Alternately third element from left is replaced by new elements i.e 'D' is replaced by 'S' and 'R' is replaced by 'T'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f0a6341155571c8210c023ad1b9de8adba9205b341806bd90d1f837bd412924.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef36c46b79752bd18b6c95a57edb5a0b98be415edce619d18229a2955bbff33.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (2)’ is the correct answer.
